title: Request List Item
description: A single item on a request list (also called a PBC - 'prepared by client' - list). Each item is something the firm needs from the client to do the work: a document, a piece of information, or a confirmation. Request items drive the client-side chase loop and feed close open-items and tax-prep gathering.

label.description: Short name of what is being requested, e.g. "Prior-year tax return", "May bank statement - operating account".

description.description: Optional longer explanation of the request.

itemType.description: The nature of what is requested.

category.description: Optional taxonomy bucket for grouping items on a request list (e.g. bank, payroll, fixed-assets, prior-year, identity).

status.description: Fulfilment state. The chase loop runs requested -> reminded -> received -> accepted (or rejected, or waived).

required.description: Whether the item blocks the work if not provided.

remindersSent.description: Count of reminders sent for this item.
